comment: The four growth knobs are not in panel order: reading the panel left to right they are angle variation (param 0), branching variation (param 1), branching (param 3) and sun force (param 2), so the last two are swapped against their index order. The mutation chance parameter has no widget on the panel and lives only on the right-click menu. The manual says the growth controls have a negligible effect on the sequences, and the code bears that out: they change the shape of the tree, and the sequence values come from random numbers assigned to each branch rather than from its geometry. The display drawing the tree is a single widget; nothing on it can be clicked for help.
